notes.title: FailFactory is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Introducing FailFactory, the first explosive title from the minds at IL Labs — an indie studio fueled by pure passion, creativity, and caffeine.

Crafted in under three weeks by two self-taught developers, FailFactory is proof that no dream is too big and no deadline too short when you're driven by love for games. What started as a wild concept became a fully playable, adrenaline-packed experience — packed with quirky physics, unpredictable hazards, and plenty of opportunities to laugh at your own failure.

💥 What to expect:
– Fast-paced, side-scrolling action
– One-touch chaotic fun reminiscent of Jetpack Joyride
– Outrageous factory-themed obstacles
– Addictive runs where failure is part of the fun

🎮 This is just the beginning. FailFactory is the first of many titles coming your way from IL Labs, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Get in, suit up, and see how far you can go before the factory breaks you!
